milestone: T05 screen-edge effects and tucked short stacks; T06 awaits approval
testScope: All six Wallet interaction cases and four native accessibility/navigation cases passed with final app sources. The remaining audit then passed after only three exact fictional row fragments within the native bottom blur/toolbar band were documented as expected occluded content. Pixel diagnostics are preserved; the low-contrast faded date is not claimed as readable until scrolled above the band. Short-stack geometry is checked for one, two and three receipts, including expansion/return. Import is actually tapped in empty and populated wallets. Prior unit checks cover the unchanged domain/date/storage code. Early diagnostic runs identified pocket hit interception and a Debug-only badge contrast finding; the backing is now a separate non-interactive layer, and the test-only safe-area badge is removed so test geometry matches normal launch. A hard clip and blank bottom spacer in the collection List also caused cropped-row findings; both are removed in favor of the native soft edge effect. Outside that precise occluded band, structural and reading/action checks remain strict.

referenceComparison.observed: Content continues beneath fixed controls with progressively blurred screen-edge transitions; no custom center-frame mask.

visualReview: retained layers and scroll position on return
limits: Hardware camera, device protection and VoiceOver remain for the iPhone phase
Narrow contrast exceptions do not certify native material/device contrast
User design review and T06 approval remain pending
